Definition: to space off; intensive (evenly) to make equidistant
BiblicalUsage: The boards of the tabernacle were set in order by this word, two tenons in one board, equally distant one from another. Every board was made the same way, so that the whole house would stand straight.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts the tenons of His house, and the tabernacle stood because every board was spaced the same.
